donor_subset: First eight lexicographically sorted sample IDs in the pinned release VCF header.
relatedness_policy: Retain source pedigree labels when available. This is a transductive computation; related or unknown-kinship records provide no independent-validation claim.
guide_selection: Use the existing reference-verified Mayuranathan -198 guide from tests/test_external_coordinate_verification.py. Confirm its two declared 23-base targets and NGG PAMs against reference before reading donor genotypes. Fail on mismatch.
variant_scope: Literal substitutions and normalized simple indels with REF and ALT lengths at most 50; unsupported carried or uncertain records retain donor-specific gaps.
quality: Accept source PASS and dot as distinct recorded states. No new DP or GQ threshold: the phased panel supplies no per-sample confident reference-callability contract. Keep every retained missing call unknown.
phase: VCF implicit phase-set convention; explicit incompatible PS blocks remain unresolved locally.
assay_scenario: Simulated allele- and locus-resolved assays in a declared HSPC editing context; public genome records establish no specimen availability or laboratory feasibility.
claims: Bounded conditional nomination and planned coverage only. No observed editing, empirical sensitivity, independent donor prediction, singleton completeness or biological safety claim.
status: Protocol frozen before retrieving donor genotypes or comparing outcomes. Retrieved files receive actual checksums; inaccessible data are a blocked gate.
